title: Rewind configuration condition
statement: An amplified configuration $C$ is at rewind for run index $j\in\text{Fin}(r+1)$ and counter $c\in\text{Fin}(r+2)$ precisely when its phase state is that rewind state, its output is empty, and every work tape whose assigned block index is less than $j$ is blank at every cell with its head at position zero.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define how work tapes are assigned block indices.
